name: Malaysian Thesis Institution System (MTIS) eval set

cases.input: GET /health
cases.expect: status is ok and service is mtis-backend

cases.input: Unauthenticated access to /dashboard
cases.expect: Redirect to /login within 5 seconds with 401 unauthenticated enforcement

cases.input: User in Tenant A requests project in Tenant B via GET /projects/{id}
cases.expect: HTTP 403 Forbidden with cross-tenant refusal message and zero data leaked

cases.input: POST /api/search with query 'e-wallet adoption SME Malaysia' and scope 'MY'
cases.expect: HTTP 200 with >=10 structured papers, latency under 30s, and source tags

cases.input: POST /api/search with query 'asdfghjkl12345'
cases.expect: HTTP 422 with inline field error and zero database mutation

cases.input: POST /api/search with duplicate papers across OpenAlex and UTM
cases.expect: Deduplicated results with zero duplicate DOIs

cases.input: LLM returns malformed JSON on initial try and repair retry
cases.expect: HTTP 422 with defined failure message: 'The AI returned an invalid response. Your progress is saved — retry Stage X.' and database state intact

cases.input: Out-of-policy non-research or abusive prompt submitted to AI agent
cases.expect: HTTP 400 polite refusal before any paid API call with cost_myr 0.00 in ai_calls log

cases.input: User with 0 remaining generation quota invokes AI stage
cases.expect: HTTP 429 quota refusal before any paid call with cost_myr 0.00 in ai_calls log

cases.input: DEMO_MODE=true with zero API keys runs full 4-stage pipeline
cases.expect: All stages complete on fixtures with status no_key_mode and cost_myr 0.00

cases.input: Simulated browser refresh mid-pipeline after Stage 2 and Stage 3
cases.expect: Exact state restored from projects.state_json with last_saved metadata and zero duplication

cases.input: Full project state runs Stage 5 Plan Generation
cases.expect: HTTP 200 within 30s with structured plan schema (objectives, milestones, timeline, resources), plan_version=1, and DB persistence

cases.input: Refinement prompt submitted via POST /api/plan/refine
cases.expect: HTTP 200 with plan_version=2, demonstrably updated plan JSON in DB, and last_refined_at recorded

cases.input: Operational validation: db_backup.py and db_restore.py execution
cases.expect: SQL backup generated >10KB and restore completes with exit code 0
